audit.whatIsWrong: full.phases[6] (2+ items) has side='Senna' but its own why text says 'Late Lulu deletes dives: poly the assassin, grow the carry, and watch their plan become a squirrel' — the row argues with itself. content.win[6] already says 'Lulu'.
audit.why: This is exactly the self-contradicting-row pattern the chart rule warns about: the why was already written for a Lulu-favoured late game (matching content.late: 'your Wild Growth and double shields hard-peel her single-target crits ... you win the scaling 2v2'), only side and rating were left on the stale value.
audit.corrected: Flip phases[6].side to Lulu; why needs no change since it already describes Lulu winning.

audit.why: Levels 1-2 (Senna out-ranging with Piercing Darkness poke) and Level 3 (Polymorph coming online) are the real swing points and content.spikes already covers them.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.wants.foe says Senna will 'Root-zone with E mist and pick your ADC from the fog' — Senna's E (Curse of the Black Mist) has no CC flag at all; it's a camouflage zone. The root ability is W (Last Embrace), already covered separately in wants.foe.
audit.why: Kit authority: Senna's E grants Wraith camouflage and move speed to allies inside it — it enables an unseen flank/pick, it does not root. Calling it a 'root-zone' invents a second CC source that doesn't exist.
audit.corrected: Rewrite to describe the actual effect: vanishing into the mist to flank unseen.

edits.before: Root-zone with E mist and pick your ADC from the fog
edits.after: Vanish into E mist to flank unseen and pick your ADC

notes: No win[N] edit needed for the 2+ items row — content.win[6] was already 'Lulu' and correct; only the full-layer side/rating were stale and self-contradicted their own why text. Fixed a fabricated CC claim on Senna's E (Curse of the Black Mist has no hardCC flag; the root is W Last Embrace, already named elsewhere in wants.foe). breakdown.early/mid/wave/trading/feeding/carry/late and tldr/winCon/enemyWin/ahead/tradeGood/tradeBad/loading remain the shared cross-matchup template and were left alone for time. breakdown.cooldowns for senna does already cite a real ability name and describes Last Embrace's root spread — it was left as-is since it names the correct ability and reads as champion-specific rather than templated filler.
